items.reason: Signed-in GET /user/login?returnUrl=%20%2F%2Fevil.example returns 302 Location: http://evil.example/, and the browser requests http://evil.example/. A leading space makes url[0] != '/', so the value reaches the final branch. Uri.TryCreate(" //evil.example", UriKind.Relative) succeeds, so the value is returned unchanged. NavigateTo resolves it against the base URI, and Uri strips the leading whitespace, which leaves the protocol-relative //evil.example.
items.fix: Return '/' for any returnUrl that starts or ends with whitespace (e.g. char.IsWhiteSpace(returnUrl[0])), or Trim() it before applying the '/' and '\\' checks. A more robust option is to resolve with Nav.ToAbsoluteUri(url) and require its scheme and authority to match new Uri(Nav.BaseUri). Add ' //evil.example' as a case in the protocol-relative test in auth-login.spec.ts.
